items.exampleEn: Healing is usually faster in young people.
items.exampleZh: 年輕人通常復原得比較快。

items.exampleEn: Small cuts on the face often bleed a lot.
items.exampleZh: 臉上的小傷口常常流很多血。

items.exampleEn: Some frogs have poison in their skin.
items.exampleZh: 有些青蛙的皮膚裡有毒。

items.exampleEn: My eyes are sore from looking at the screen.
items.exampleZh: 我盯著螢幕看，眼睛好痠痛。

items.exampleEn: The new shoes caused some discomfort at first.
items.exampleZh: 新鞋一開始穿起來有點不舒服。

items.exampleEn: The dog found the skeleton of a bird in the garden.
items.exampleZh: 狗在花園裡發現一副鳥的骨骼。

items.exampleEn: The number of smokers in our city is going down.
items.exampleZh: 我們城市的吸菸人數在減少。

items.sentenceEn: My arms felt sore after I painted the room.
items.sentenceZh: 我油漆完房間後手臂好痠。

items.audioEn: Smokers can use the area behind the hotel, but not the garden.
items.audioZh: 吸菸者可以使用飯店後面的區域，但不能在花園裡。
items.questionZh: 吸菸者可以在哪裡抽菸？
options: At the back of the hotel

items.sentenceEn: His knee needed two weeks of healing after the fall.
items.sentenceZh: 他跌倒後，膝蓋花了兩週才癒合。

items.sentenceEn: Cover your mouth when you cough.

items.stemEn: A human ____ has more than two hundred bones.
items.stemZh: 人體骨骼有兩百多塊骨頭。

items.stemEn: After walking all day, my feet were ____.
items.stemZh: 走了一整天，我的腳好痠痛。

items.passageEn: For many years, my grandfather was a heavy smoker. He often coughed and felt discomfort in his chest. Ten years ago, he stopped smoking. "Cigarettes are like poison," he says. Now he walks for an hour every day. He also works as a volunteer at the science museum, where he shows children a human skeleton and answers their questions.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺以前抽菸抽得很兇，抽了很多年。他常常咳嗽，胸口也不舒服。十年前，他戒了菸。他說：「香菸就像毒藥。」現在他每天走路一小時。他也在科學博物館當志工，向孩子們介紹人體骨骼，回答他們的問題。

questions.questionZh: 爺爺以前常有什麼問題？
爺爺現在在博物館做什麼？

rubricZh: bleed 表示「流血」，例如 start to bleed、is bleeding 等說法
時態配合內容（例如過去式、現在進行式等）

items.promptZh: 有些人在高山上會感到不適。
referenceEn: Some people feel discomfort high up in the mountains.
Some people feel discomfort in high mountains.
rubricZh: 用 discomfort 表示「不適」（例如 feel discomfort）
「在高山上」可寫，例如 high up in the mountains、in high mountains 等
